close_reason: Simplified borrow dance: let on_demand; let set = match ... — eliminated owned Option wrapper
description: common/mod.rs email_matches_condition (lines 1847-1868): the inMailboxOtherThan on-demand path declares 'let owned: Option<HashSet<&Id>>' before a match, assigns it inside the None branch, then immediately borrows it as 'owned.as_ref().unwrap()'. The two-variable dance (owned + set) is needed to satisfy the borrow checker but forces a reader to trace the ownership across four lines to understand what 'set' points to. This is the fallback path (the pre-built set is passed in the hot path), so it rarely executes. Suggested rewrite: collapse to a single let binding at the start of the if-block: 'let on_demand; let set = excluded_set.unwrap_or_else(|| { on_demand = ...; &on_demand });' or use a Cow, eliminating the intermediate Option.
title: email_matches_condition: owned/set borrow dance for on-demand HashSet
